proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Adults (20-45) passionate about historical swordplay, fencing history, and medieval combat. They spend heavily on high-end protective gear, synthetic swords, and historical treatises.
product_angles: Historical fencing training logbooks with custom combat-stance tracking templates (KDP)
SVG vector packs of authentic historical weapon postures from 15th-century manuals (Etsy)
3D printable wall mounts and tabletop stands for feder swords or bucklers (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Training Journal & Sparring Logbook (KDP, 120 pages, matte cover with historical woodcut art)

proposals.name: Wind Turbine Technicians (Industrial Climbers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Blue-collar specialized workers operating high above ground. High pride in their extreme job, strong brotherhood culture, heavy use of insider jokes about weather, heights, torque, and turbine brands (Vestas, Siemens).
product_angles: Redbubble sticker packs containing wind-turbine humor and acronyms (e.g., LOTO, Nacelle Life)
Maintenance and torque inspection notebook templates (KDP)
SVG designs for laser-engraving on rugged thermal flasks (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Wind Tech Sticker Pack: 6 insider humor vector designs (Redbubble / Etsy SVGs)

proposals.name: Low-Poly Retro Gamedev Assets (PS1/Boomer Shooter Style)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building retro-horror, sci-fi, or boomer shooter games. They need lightweight, stylistically coherent 3D models and textures that evoke the late 90s aesthetic.
product_angles: Retro industrial/sci-fi low-poly 3D props (Cults3D/Itch.io)
Tileable retro pixel-art texture packs (Etsy/Itch.io)
Retro-style UI/HUD vector asset bundles (Etsy/SVG)
proposals.first_test_product: PS1-Style Retro Industrial Prop Pack (15 low-poly STL/FBX assets: crates, pipes, terminal screens)

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists, often older but highly dedicated, who build radio stations to communicate globally. They collect QSL cards (confirmation of contact) and track contacts meticulously.
product_angles: Customizable QSL Card templates designed for easy printing (Etsy)
Ham Radio Contact Logbooks with specialized tables for frequency, signal strength, and UTC times (KDP)
Patent art-style vector posters of classic vintage radio rigs (Etsy/Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: The Ultimate Ham Radio Operator's Logbook (KDP, 150 pages, optimized layout for rapid logging)

proposals.name: Local French Hiking Trails & GR Enthusiasts (B2B/B2C)
proposals.buyer_persona: Hikers passionate about iconic French trails (GR20, GR34, Saint-Jacques) and local tourism offices seeking high-quality local merchandise.
product_angles: Topographical elevation profile SVG vectors of specific trail sections (Etsy)
3D printable trail markers, topographical relief maps, or keychains (Cults3D)
Trail logbooks featuring stage checklists and wildlife guides (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: GR34 (Sentier des Douaniers) Elevation Map SVG & Minimalist Poster Design (Etsy)

proposals.name: Eurorack Modular Synthesizer Collectors
proposals.buyer_persona: Electronic music producers, gear nerds, and sound designers who build modular synths. They spend thousands on hardware and value clean, industrial, cyberpunk, or minimalist retro aesthetics.
product_angles: Modular synth patch sheet design notebooks for documenting knob positions (KDP)
3D-printable Eurorack blank panels, cable organizers, or desktop stands (Cults3D)
Geometric, schematic-style vector art of vintage synthesizer circuits (Etsy/Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: Modular Synth Patch Book: 100 blank patch templates for Eurorack modules (KDP)

proposals.name: Speleologists & Cave Explorers
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly adventurous individuals navigating extreme cave systems. They rely on specialized gear, strict safety protocols, and have a rich sub-culture with terms like 'squeeze', 'SRT', and 'karst'.
product_angles: Cave mapping symbol reference guides and logbooks (KDP)
Speleo humor stickers featuring vertical caving and tight squeeze jokes (Redbubble)
SVG vector packs of cave wildlife, mapping symbols, and climbing rigs (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Caving & Speleology Expedition Logbook: Waterproof-look cover with cave survey layout (KDP)
